newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUGER-G WINNER ALPHAND.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUGER-G WINNER ALPHAND.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a men's World Cup super giant slalom on Wednesday:

World Cup wins: 10. Downhills - Kitzbuehel (97), Val Gardena ( 97), Bormio (97), Garmisch-Partenkirchen (96), Kitzbuehel (95), Kitzbuehel (95), Bormio (95) Vail (95), Val d'Isere (95), super- G - Laax (97)

Other notable achievements: Two times reigning World Cup downhill champion. Downhill bronze medallist at the 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. Career disrupted by serious injuries, list of which is nearly as long as his triumphs. After tearing knee ligaments at Whistler in 1993, he seriously considered retiring. Enjoys hunting, rally driving and moto- cross. Competed in one round French moto-cross championships this spring.
